import glob
import re

import clike as C

ORIGINAL = 'use std::collections::HashMap;\n\npub fn parse_sku(code: &str) -> Result<(String, u32), String> {\n    let (prefix, rest) = code.split_once(\'-\').ok_or_else(|| format!("bad sku: {}", code))?;\n    if !["VEG", "HRB", "FLW"].contains(&prefix) {\n        return Err(format!("bad sku: {}", code));\n    }\n    let n: u32 = rest.parse().map_err(|_| format!("bad sku: {}", code))?;\n    Ok((prefix.to_string(), n))\n}\n\npub fn add_lot(stock: &mut HashMap<String, u32>, sku: &str, qty: u32) -> Result<u32, String> {\n    if qty == 0 {\n        return Err("quantity must be positive".to_string());\n    }\n    parse_sku(sku)?;\n    let entry = stock.entry(sku.to_string()).or_insert(0);\n    *entry += qty;\n    Ok(*entry)\n}\n\npub fn low_stock(stock: &HashMap<String, u32>, threshold: u32) -> Vec<String> {\n    let mut out: Vec<String> = stock.iter().filter(|(_, &q)| q < threshold).map(|(k, _)| k.clone()).collect();\n    out.sort();\n    out\n}\n\npub fn format_label(sku: &str, qty: u32) -> Result<String, String> {\n    let (prefix, number) = parse_sku(sku)?;\n    Ok(format!("{} #{:04} x{}", prefix, number, qty))\n}\n'
FUNCS = ['parse_sku', 'add_lot', 'low_stock', 'format_label']
FALLIBLE = ['parse_sku', 'add_lot', 'format_label']
problems = []
src = C.read("src/lib.rs")
if re.sub(r"\s+", "", C.clean(src, "rust")) != re.sub(r"\s+", "", C.clean(ORIGINAL, "rust")):
    problems.append("the code changed: only comments may be added")
lines = src.split("\n")
if not any(ln.startswith("//!") for ln in lines):
    problems.append("the crate needs `//!` documentation at the top of src/lib.rs")
for name in FUNCS:
    idx = next((i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"\s*pub fn " + name + r"\b", ln)), None)
    if idx is None:
        problems.append(name + ": not found")
        continue
    doc = []
    j = idx - 1
    while j >= 0 and lines[j].lstrip().startswith("///"):
        doc.insert(0, lines[j].lstrip()[3:])
        j -= 1
    text = "\n".join(doc)
    if not text.strip():
        problems.append(name + ": no `///` documentation")
        continue
    blocks = re.findall(r"```[a-z]*\n(.*?)```", text, re.S)
    if not any("assert" in b for b in blocks):
        problems.append(name + ": the documentation needs an example in a code block that asserts something")
    if name in FALLIBLE and not re.search(r"^\s?# Errors", text, re.M):
        problems.append(name + ": functions returning Result need an `# Errors` section")
C.report(problems)
